predictions.articleTitle: Puissalicon vs Riviera Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Regional 3 Hosts Halt N2 Firepower?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Riviera FC are projected to secure a decisive regulation-time Away Win over three-tier-lower AS Puissalicon-Magalas in a match clearing 2.5 total goals.

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Fifth-tier Riviera FC test eighth-tier cup darlings Puissalicon at Béziers.

spf.comment: Aligned with the 0:3 primary scoreline, Riviera FC's fifth-tier offensive and defensive quality across 90 minutes should overcome eighth-tier Puissalicon without needing extra time.

over_under.comment: Riviera's 1.88 goals per National 2 match and 4-2 Round 7 win meet a Puissalicon defense coming off a 0-4 league loss.

btts.comment: Riviera concede just 0.75 goals per game in National 2 Poule G and face an eighth-tier attack shut out 0-4 last weekend.

score.comment: Both scorelines reflect Riviera's structural dominance over 90 minutes, splitting between a controlled shutout and a consolation-goal branch.

bqc.comment: From home side Puissalicon's perspective, Riviera either establish control before half-time or break through after the interval as fatigue sets in.
